Rather than compete on price with a well-capitalized competitor (memory_73 shows pricing works but memory_57 suggests it may not be sustainable for long-term value), the strategic choice is to improve product-side activation. Memory_91 showed activation messaging improved week-one engagement. Memory_86 showed shortened onboarding lifted adoption. Both are product levers that work together.
